objectives_fil: Gumawa ng maikling ulat para sa midwife na may concern, pinagmulan at hindi pa tiyak na detalye, hinihinging aksyon at ligtas na paraan ng pagpapadala.
objectives_en: Prepare a short handoff for the midwife containing the concern, sources and uncertainty, requested action and a secure delivery method.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ihiwalay ang concern, pinagmulan at kulang na detalye; ang hinihingi ay hindi pa napagkasunduan.
sections.takeaway_en: Separate the concern, source and missing detail; a request is not yet an agreement.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tiyakin ang awtorisadong tatanggap at lokal na aprubadong paraan; ibahagi lamang ang kailangan.
sections.takeaway_en: Verify the authorized recipient and locally approved method; share only what is needed.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa pulong, sapat na pattern at malinaw na tanong; ang pribadong kaso ay sa awtorisadong tatanggap.
sections.takeaway_en: At a meeting, give a sufficient pattern and a clear question; private cases go to the authorized recipient.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang pagtanggap at ang napagkasunduan: sino, ano, at kailan o paano mag-follow-up.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm receipt and the agreement: who, what, and when or how to follow up.

sections.takeaway_fil: Magsanay sa pag-uulat, pagsagot sa paglilinaw at pagkumpirma; ulitin ang bahaging kulang.
sections.takeaway_en: Practise reporting, answering clarification and confirming; retry the missing part.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ibahagi ang kailangan ng tamang tatanggap; tiyakin ang pagtanggap at sundan ang napagkasunduan.
sections.takeaway_en: Share what the right recipient needs; verify receipt and follow up on the agreement.

check.prompt_fil: Humihingi ang barangay meeting ng paliwanag sa missed visits. Ano ang ibabahagi?
check.prompt_en: A barangay meeting asks about missed visits. What should be shared?

options.fil: Ang pinagsamang childcare barrier at tanong tungkol sa iskedyul.
options.en: The aggregated childcare barrier and a question about scheduling.

options.fil: Mga larawan ng household forms para kumpleto.
options.en: Photos of household forms for completeness.

options.fil: Pangalan ng bawat pamilya at opinyon ng kapitbahay.
options.en: Each family’s name and the neighbor’s opinion.

check.feedback_fil: Una: Ang pinagsamang childcare barrier at tanong tungkol sa iskedyul ay sapat para sa pagpaplano, kung walang detalyeng makakakilala sa pamilya. Ikalawa: Ang larawan ng household forms ay naglalantad ng hindi kailangang pribadong detalye; hindi iyon ang kailangan ng grupo. Ikatlo: Ang pangalan at opinyon ng kapitbahay ay hindi angkop; ang opinyon ay hindi ebidensya ng dahilan. Sa wakas, tinanggap ng chair ang pinagsamang buod at napagkasunduang itanong niya sa itinalagang health team member ang paraan ng paglilinaw sa iskedyul sa susunod na coordination meeting. Kinumpirma ni Gibs kung sino ang gagawa at paano kukunin ang sagot. Hiwalay niyang kinumpirma sa awtorisadong midwife ang pagtanggap ng indibidwal na ulat at kanilang follow-up. Walang ipinangakong appointment o childcare.
check.feedback_en: First: The aggregated childcare barrier and scheduling question are sufficient for planning if no details identify a household. Second: Photographs of household forms expose unnecessary private details; the group does not need them. Third: Names and a neighbor’s opinion are inappropriate; an opinion is not evidence of the cause. In the ending, the chair acknowledges the aggregated summary and agrees to ask the designated health team member how to clarify scheduling at the next coordination meeting. Gibs confirms who will act and how to obtain the response. Separately, he confirms that the authorized midwife received the individual report and checks their follow-up agreement. No appointment or childcare is promised.
